verses.restored: Praise ye YHWH. I will praise YHWH with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

familiar.text: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

modern.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

original.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה

verses.restored: The works of YHWH are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

familiar.text: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

modern.text: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

original.text: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכָל חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

familiar.text: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

modern.text: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.

original.text: הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר פָּֽעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד

verses.restored: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: YHWH is gracious and full of compassion.

familiar.text: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

modern.text: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

original.text: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He hath given meat to them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

familiar.text: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

modern.text: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

original.text: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He hath showed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the nations.

familiar.text: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

modern.text: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

original.text: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם

verses.restored: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

familiar.text: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

modern.text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

original.text: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל פִּקּוּדָֽיו

verses.restored: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

familiar.text: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

modern.text: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

original.text: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר

verses.restored: He sent redemption to his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

familiar.text: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

modern.text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

original.text: פְּד֤וּת שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ

verses.restored: The fear of YHWH is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

familiar.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

modern.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
